messages:
Maya Iyer: FYI vendor dispute from ClearRoute: they say they were billed twice for webhooks that returned 502s yesterday. Can eng confirm if retries were double-counted?
Noah Kim: Which invoice/window?
Maya Iyer: Invoice 2026-03-19-CR, window ~14:42-14:47 UTC. Billing shows 420k tokens; request logs 330k.
Sara Velasquez: We had a webhook delivery retry loop on the transformer service at 14:43 due to a transient NGINX upstream 502. The webhook client retried the full payload without idempotency.
Tom Bender: Our billing emits tokens at event finalize; but webhook retries can re-trigger finalize if not deduped by delivery_id. Looks likely.
billing-bot: [automated] alert billing-runner 2026-03-19 flagged delivery_retry_duplicates for route /v1/webhook/ingest
Noah Kim: I'll join request_ids -> delivery_event_ids and dedupe. Give me 10m.
Sara Velasquez: Also check vendor-side receipts; they may have accepted only one delivery. We should compare our delivery_attempt count vs vendor ack logs.
Maya Iyer: Finance needs delta per invoice and estimated credit amount. Priya is out today so tag me for $ calc. Use enterprise tier C rates: $0.00085/1k gen, embeddings negligible.
Noah Kim: Quick query: billed_tokens=420,120; unique_request_tokens=330,410; delta=89,710.
Maya Iyer: delta calc -> 89.71k/1k * $0.00085 = $0.076. That's tiny; odd that invoice difference looked big because of rounding across routes. Still proceed with credit note.
Tom Bender: I'll add a delivery_id header to the transformer so retries include original delivery_id and make billing rely on that for dedupe. Hotfix ETA 2h.
Maya Iyer: Action items: (1) Noah export CSV to /shared/finance/reconciliations/1782504321-webhook-audit.csv (2) Tom push delivery_id dedupe hotfix (3) Finance issue small credit memo and notify ClearRoute.
billing-bot: [automated] credit-memo-generator queued for invoice 2026-03-19-CR (status=queued)
Maya Iyer: Thanks team. Close after CSV and credit memo posted. :white_check_mark:
